purpose: Docs-level binding of the CAPTURE_ONLY campaign policy bundle for CAMPAIGN_MANIFEST_CAPTURE_ONLY_V2.json. This is a pinned manifest of component files; release.policy_bundle_sha256 in the V2 manifest = raw-bytes sha256 of THIS file. It does not replace the full 15-component REQUIRED_POLICY_COMPONENTS cluster (src/policy_governance_pr143.py) that governs execution admission; that full cluster remains out of scope for a CAPTURE_ONLY data campaign.

hash_conventions.raw_bytes_sha256: sha256 of the file's raw bytes (scripts/qualify_release.py:174 convention)
hash_conventions.canonical_json_sha256: sha256 of json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), allow_nan=False) (src/qualification_campaign/identity.py digest(); used by runtime authority generation_bindings)

components.role: DIN-00 source admission ledger (37 providers, all disabled)
offline provider contract/docs pins consumed by radar capture
rooted runtime truth policy (already bound inside runtime authority generation_bindings)
retention policy referenced by the evidence journal budget

operator_approval.note: The bundle binding is computed offline from committed repo files; campaign start still requires explicit operator approval of the V2 manifest (quotas, retention, profiles) and of any real capture run.
